$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Updates and Announcements settings (cx-d5b5d). scripts/cmux-next/gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and the parser constants (paths, defaults, ranges, choice values) from this file; schemas/settings/settings-schema.json is still exported from Swift and must not change when this file moves. Row fields: key (dotted cmux.json path), name (identifier for generated constants; default the last path part), title/help/summary {key: string catalog key, text: English}, kind (toggle | number | choice | folder_list | string_list), choices [{value, title}], range {min, max, step, unit, placeholder (default min)}, default, aliases {old value: value it loads as}, keywords, placeholder {key, text} (what an empty list field shows; a list row only), note (developer note, not shown).

rows.note: The one update choice (Leo 2026-11-22: "the toggle for \"automatic update\" seems vacuous if we're saying yeah ok it can auto download"; "maybe too many settings and bullshit that can be consolidated"). How far cmux goes by itself on one ladder: check, download, install. It replaced updates.checkAutomatically, updates.downloadAutomatically and updates.installWhenIdle (retired-keys.json reads them while this is unset). Download Automatically by default on every channel (Leo's #39680, 2026-11-23: download in the background, install only on Restart to Update). Design: cmuxterm-hq docs/design/update-settings.md.

help.text: Install When Idle restarts cmux once you have been away, never while an agent works or a message is unsent. Terminals and agents keep running.

rows.note: Live daemon updates between app updates (Leo 2026-11-22: "i wonder how many we can actually just ship and not even need the user to restart to update, tbh."): NIGHTLY and tip builds only. The app's own daemon reads this key (cmux-tui cli/app/try_cmd/daemon_updates.rs): at Every Merge it checks the signed mac-live channel and, while no agent works and input is quiet, runs the bundled `cmux --json app try channel`, which swaps Contents/Resources/bin and hands the terminal daemon over. Swift only shows the row. Off by default.

help.text: Every merge's background services (terminals, agents' daemon) update in place, with no restart. NIGHTLY only.

rows.note: Your own web edits, live in this app (docs/cmux-next/hot-reload.md): pages and agent panes load from the server or overlay ~/.config/cmux/web-dev.json names, in WebKit and Chromium, in every build. On by default (Leo 2026-11-05: "we probably want to have this feature like toggleable on by default"); a missing web-dev.json changes nothing.

help.text: Lets cmux live start show your checkout's web UI, each saved edit at once.
